question: Who among the following took part in India's freedom struggle from the North-East?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rani Gaidinliu.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Rani Gaidinliu** was a** freedom fighter **from **Manipur **who spent 14 years in jail for fighting the British. 
 
• She was **a spiritual and political leader of Nagas **who led a revolt against British rule in India.
 
• Gaidinliu was** arrested in 1932 at the age of 16 **and was **sentenced to life imprisonment by the British rulers.**
 
• After spending her youth years in jail, **Gaidinliu was released in 1947 when India became independent.**
 
• **Jawaharlal Nehru,** ’**gave her the title of “Rani” (“Queen”),** and she gained local popularity as Rani Gaidinliu.
 
• She established a tribal organization, **Kabini Samiti in 1934.**
 
• Rani Gandinliu’s **association with Jadonang and Heeraka movement** pushed her into the fight with the British.
 
• After the execution of Jadonang, **she took up the leadership of the movement **which slowly turned political from religious.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Malati Choudhuri**

 
 
• ** A dedicated freedom fighter.**
 
• She **accompanied Acharya Vinoba Bhave during Bhoodan Movement.**
 
• Malati Choudhury also** joined Gandhiji during his Noakhali visit.**
 
• **Gandhiji affectionately called her `Tofanee`.**
 
• She **led the `Krisaka Andolana`**to to save the poor farmers from the grasp of Landowners and Moneylenders.
 
• In 1946 Malati Choudhury was **selected as a member of the Constituent Assembly of India.**
 
• She was also elected as the** president of the Utkal Pradesh Congress Committee.** 
 
 
 
• **Anjalai Ammal​**
 
 
• She was **a social worker and reformer from Kadalur.**
 
• She started her political activism in **1921 with the Non-Cooperation Movement.**
 
• Also** took part in the Neil Statue Satyagraha, Salt Satyagraha, and Quit India Movement.**
 
• **Mahatma Gandhi called her South India's Jhansi Rani.** 
 
• **In 1931, she presided over The All India Women Congress Meet. **
 
 
 
• **Sucheta Kriplani​**
 
 
• ​Sucheta Kripalani was an** Indian freedom fighter and politician.**
 
• She was** India's first female Chief Minister,** serving as the head of the **Uttar Pradesh government from 1963 to 1967.**
 
 

6f:T
